title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Work-Search Standards by Program
content:
Each program of Unemployment Benefit Claims sets the number of employer contacts a claimant reports for each certified week and the circumstances in which the search is waived.

| Program | Employer contacts required per certified week | Every contact must be a verifiable application to an employer with an opening | Recall waiver (weeks after the claim effective date, with a recorded definite recall date) | Enrolment in agency-approved training waives the weekly work search |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 3 | No | 8 | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 3 | No | 8 | Yes |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 3 | No | 0 (no recall waiver) | Yes |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 3 | No | 8 | Yes |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 4 | Yes | 0 (no recall waiver) | Yes |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 0 | No | 0 (no recall waiver) | Yes |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 2 | No | 0 (no recall waiver) | Yes |

## Notes

- The contacts figure is the count a claimant must report for each certified week unless a waiver applies.
- The Extended Benefits (EB) column entry "Yes" is the systematic and sustained search: every reported contact must be a verifiable application with an employer that has an opening.
- A recall waiver figure of 0 means the program has no recall waiver.
